name: Lexoraa Industries Limited
about: Lexoraa Industries Limited trades, imports, and exports gold, silver, diamonds, precious stones, and related jewelry items in India. The company also engages in dealing in bullion, antiques, and artistic articles; and operation of showrooms and retail outlets for its products. In addition, it is involved in the trade, import, export, and distribution of agricultural, horticultural, and other agro-based products including fruits, vegetables, edible oils, organic food, dairy products, health food, protein food, fast-moving consumer goods, and packaged food; and manufacture, repair, distribution, and dealing in machinery, equipment, tools, solvent extraction, refining, vanaspati, cattle feed, oil milling and chemical processing. The company was formerly known as Servoteach Industries Limited and changed its name to Lexoraa Industries Limited in June 2024. Lexoraa Industries Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
